name: Jordan Rivera
headline: Faster go-lives.
intro: Most recently Director of Operations at Tidewater Freight Systems, a 420-person transportation software company. I run implementation, support, and training as one post-sale team, and I brought an acquired company's people and customers onto one platform without losing them.

stats.label: Weeks to go live, after rebuilding onboarding.
Acquired customers kept through year one.
